resources.string: One link in. The right browser out.
Wyelink is not your default browser yet
Links reach Wyelink only when it is the default browser. It opens nothing itself: it hands each link to Browser 1 or Browser 2 in a few milliseconds.
Login, OAuth, verify and confirm links, plus anything in “Always Browser 1”.

Scores each link: sign-in providers (Google, Microsoft, Apple, Okta, Auth0…), login, OAuth, verify and confirm pages, magic-link and reset tokens. Sees through Outlook Safe Links, Proofpoint, Google and Facebook redirects. Works offline.
Treat in-app browser tabs as sign-ins
Apps open their login screens as “Custom Tabs”. Turn on to send every in-app tab to Browser 1 (some apps use tabs for ordinary links too).
Show which browser opened each link

One rule per line. Rules beat smart routing.
example.com domain + subdomains
example.com/login domain + path
app:com.slack links opened from an app
has:invoice URL contains text
re:^https://.*\.gov/ regular expression
# comment
Paste a URL to see where it goes
Off by default. Stores only the site and path of the last 15 links, never the part after “?” where tokens live. Stays on this phone.
Nothing routed yet. Tip: copy a package name from here into an app: rule.
